procedures.title: Daily Visual Inspection
steps: Check for engine oil leaks
Check for fuel leaks
Check for engine coolant leaks
Check for damaged or missing parts
Check for loose, missing or damaged fasteners
Check electrical harnesses for cracks, abrasions, and damaged or corroded connectors
Check hoses for cracks, abrasions, and damaged, loose or corroded clamps
Check fuel filter/water separator for presence of water and contaminants
procedures.expected_outcome: No leaks, damage, or contamination found
warnings: If any problem is noted during visual check, take corrective action before operating engine

procedures.title: Check Diesel Fuel Level
steps: Check fuel level in fuel tank
Refill if necessary
Prepare sufficient fuel for day's operation
warnings: Never refuel with engine running

procedures.title: Check Engine Oil Level
preconditions: Engine stopped for at least 10 minutes
steps: Remove dipstick and wipe with clean cloth
Fully reinsert dipstick
Remove dipstick and check oil level
Oil level should be between upper and lower lines on dipstick
Add oil if necessary
Fully reinsert dipstick
procedures.expected_outcome: Oil level between upper and lower limits
warnings: Never overfill engine with oil
Always keep oil level between upper and lower lines

procedures.title: Check Engine Coolant Level
steps: Check coolant level in reservoir
Level should be at FULL mark
Add coolant if necessary
Check rubber hose connecting reservoir to coolant tank
warnings: Never remove coolant filler cap if engine is hot
Never pour cold coolant into hot engine

procedures.title: Check SD60 Saildrive Oil Level
steps: Refer to operation manual for SD60 for procedure to check and fill saildrive oil
warnings: Never overfill saildrive with oil

procedures.title: Starting Engine with VC20 System
steps: Press Power switch on VC20 switch panel
If YANMAR E-key is set, hold key fob in front of blinking lamp
Enter password if Sys on by ID is set
Press control head SEL switch
Wait for display to show engine data
Enter password if Start by ID is set
Move remote control handle to N (Neutral) position
Press Engine START/STOP switch
procedures.expected_outcome: Engine starts and VC20 display shows engine conditions
warnings: Never start engine in gear
Engine will not start or stop if Power switch is OFF

procedures.title: After Engine Start Checks
steps: Check gauges, indicators and alarms are normal
Normal coolant temperature is 76-90°C (169-194°F)
Normal oil pressure at 3000 min-1 is 0.28-0.54 MPa (41-78 psi)
Check for water, fuel or oil leakage
Check smoke color, engine vibration and sound are normal
Keep engine at low speed to distribute oil to all parts
Check sufficient seawater discharge from seawater outlet
warnings: If seawater discharge is too low, stop engine immediately
Engine will seize if operated with inadequate seawater discharge

procedures.title: Warm Up Mode Operation
steps: Move remote control handle to N (Neutral) position
NEUTRAL lamp will come on
Press NTRL switch on control head
NEUTRAL lamp will flash
Move remote control handle to control engine speed while gear remains in neutral
To cancel: move handle to N position and press NTRL switch
procedures.expected_outcome: Engine speed controllable while transmission remains in neutral
warnings: Use only for warm-up purposes

procedures.title: Normal Engine Shutdown
steps: Move remote control handle to N (Neutral) position
Cool engine at low speed (below 1000 min-1) for about 5 minutes
Press Engine START/STOP switch
Press Power switch to turn power OFF
Wait 6 seconds before turning battery switch off
Turn battery switch off
Close fuel tank cock
Close seacock
warnings: Do not turn battery switch off before turning power switch off
Be sure to close seacock

procedures.title: Bleeding Fuel System
steps: Loosen air bleed screw two to three turns
Push up and down on priming pump to release air
Continue pumping until stream of fuel with no air bubbles flows (approx. 60 times)
Tighten air bleed screw
warnings: Wear safety glasses when bleeding fuel system
Diesel fuel is flammable and explosive

procedures.title: Draining Fuel Filter/Water Separator
steps: Loosen clamp screw and remove fire-resistant cover
Attach tube to drain plug
Loosen drain plug by turning counterclockwise
Drain off any water or sediment
Tighten drain plug
Remove drain tube
Install fire-resistant cover and tighten clamp screw
Bleed air from fuel system
procedures.expected_outcome: Water and contaminants removed from fuel system
warnings: Put approved container under opening to catch fuel
Wear eye protection
Wipe up spills immediately

procedures.title: Changing Engine Oil and Filter (Initial 50 Hours)
steps: Remove engine oil dipstick
Attach oil drain pump and pump out oil
Remove engine oil fill cap for easier draining
Remove oil filter with filter wrench
Install new filter element and tighten by hand until seal touches housing
Turn filter additional 3/4 turn clockwise
Fill with new engine oil
Perform trial run and check for leaks
Check oil level 10 minutes after stopping
warnings: Stay clear of hot oil to avoid burns
Never mix different types of engine oil
Never overfill

procedures.title: Checking Alternator V-ribbed Belt Tension
steps: Remove belt cover
Check belt by pushing on middle with finger (100 N force)
Belt should deflect 8-9 mm with proper tension
If adjustment needed: loosen 3 alternator bolts
Screw in adjusting bolt to move alternator
Tighten 3 alternator bolts
Install belt cover
warnings: When belt lacks tension, coolant pump will fail and engine will overheat
Never get oil on belt

procedures.title: Checking Seawater Pump Impeller
steps: Loosen side cover bolts and remove side cover
Inspect inside of seawater pump with flashlight
Check for cracked or nicked impeller blades
Check for damaged wear plate
If no damage found, install O-ring and side cover
If damage found, replace impeller
procedures.expected_outcome: Seawater pump impeller in good condition
warnings: Impeller must be replaced every 1000 hours even if not damaged

procedures.title: Replacing Fuel Filter Element
steps: Remove fuel filter with filter wrench
Hold bottom of filter with cloth to prevent spill
Apply thin film of clean diesel fuel to new filter gasket
Install new filter and hand-tighten
Use filter wrench and tighten to 20-24 N·m
Bleed fuel system
Check for fuel leaks
procedures.expected_outcome: New fuel filter installed and system bled
warnings: Put approved container under opening
Wear eye protection
Wipe up spilled fuel immediately

procedures.title: Changing Coolant
steps: Open all coolant drain cocks
Allow to drain completely
Close all drain cocks
Fill coolant tank and reservoir with appropriate coolant mixture
warnings: Wear eye protection and rubber gloves
Never mix different types of coolants
Dispose of old coolant properly

procedures.title: Cleaning Intake Silencer Element
steps: Disassemble intake silencer (air cleaner)
Remove element
Clean element and housing with neutral detergent
Dry completely and reassemble
warnings: Ensure element is completely dry before reassembly

procedures.title: Emergency Stop with VC20
steps: Press Emergency Stop switch
Emergency Stop screen will appear on display and buzzer will sound
After engine stops, press Emergency Stop switch again to release emergency stop
warnings: Use only in emergency
Engine cannot start while Emergency Stop switch is pressed

procedures.title: Engine Speed Limit Mode
steps: Move remote control handle to Forward Idle position
Press NTRL switch on control head
Lamp above NTRL switch will flash
Engine speed limited to setting value even when handle moved to accelerate
To release: move handle to N, Forward Idle, or Reverse Idle position and press NTRL switch
procedures.expected_outcome: Engine speed limited to preset value
warnings: Default setting is 50% of maximum speed

procedures.title: Normal Stopping for Folding/Feathering Propeller
preconditions: Sail drive equipped with folding or feathering propeller
steps: Move remote control handle to N (Neutral) position
Cool engine at low speed for about 5 minutes
Press Engine START/STOP switch
Set lever position to Full Reverse
Press Power switch to turn power OFF
Wait 6 seconds before turning battery switch off
Turn battery switch off
Close fuel tank cock
Close seacock
procedures.expected_outcome: Engine stopped with saildrive in reverse position for propeller folding/feathering
warnings: For twin engine, turn other power OFF within 10 seconds

procedures.title: Long-term Storage Preparation
preconditions: Engine will not be used for extended period
steps: Wipe dust or oil from engine exterior
Drain water from fuel filters
Drain fuel tank completely or fill tank to prevent condensation
Grease exposed areas and joints of remote control cables
Seal intake silencer and exhaust pipe
Completely drain bilge
Waterproof engine room
Charge battery monthly
Ensure power switch is off
warnings: Do not drain coolant system
If seawater left inside, may freeze and damage parts

procedures.title: Drain Seawater Cooling System
steps: Open seawater drain cock on marine gear cooler if equipped
Allow to drain
Remove four bolts from seawater pump side cover
Remove cover and drain seawater
Install cover and tighten bolts
Close all drain cocks
procedures.expected_outcome: Seawater system drained to prevent freeze damage
warnings: Seawater left inside may freeze and damage cooling system parts

procedures.title: Returning Engine to Service
steps: Replace oil and oil filter before running
Supply fuel if removed and prime fuel system
Confirm engine coolant is present
Operate engine at idle for 1 minute
Check fluid levels and inspect for leaks
warnings: Replace oil and filter before first start after storage

procedures.title: Racing Engine During Long Low-Speed Operation
preconditions: Engine operating at low speed for extended periods
steps: Every 2 hours, shift gear to NEUTRAL
Accelerate from low-speed to high-speed position
Repeat process about 5 times
This cleans carbon from cylinders and fuel injection valves
warnings: Neglecting to race engine will result in poor smoke color and reduced performance

procedures.title: Battery Electrolyte Level Check
steps: Remove plugs and check electrolyte level in all cells
If below minimum, fill with distilled water to upper limit
Maximum fill is 10-15 mm above plates
Replace plugs
warnings: Wear safety goggles and protective clothing
Never operate with insufficient electrolyte

procedures.title: New Engine Break-In Procedure
preconditions: Engine with less than 50 hours operation
steps: For first 10 hours: do not operate at WOT for more than 1 minute at a time
From 10-50 hours: run at maximum speed minus 400 min-1 most of the time (70% load)
Every 30 minutes: 10 minutes at maximum minus 200 min-1 (80% load)
Every 30 minutes: 4-5 minutes at WOT
Do not operate at low speed/light load for more than 30 minutes
If low speed operation necessary, race engine afterward
warnings: If operating at low speed, race engine to clean carbon buildup

procedures.title: Throttle and Shift Control
steps: For NEUTRAL: move handle to N position, NEUTRAL lamp comes on
For FORWARD: move handle toward F to forward-side notch, engine remains at idle, move further forward to increase speed
For REVERSE: move handle toward R to reverse-side notch, engine remains at idle, pull further back to increase speed
When switching between forward/reverse: move handle slowly, pause at neutral
procedures.expected_outcome: Proper gear engagement and speed control
warnings: Moving handle quickly activates gear shift delay
Ensure boat is clear of obstacles when engaging gear

procedures.title: Station Protect Function
steps: Select YES to enable Station protect
Display and control head of other stations can no longer operate
Select NO or turn off system power to disable Station protect
warnings: Function prevents operation from other stations while active

procedures.title: Troubleshooting Engine Start Failure
preconditions: Engine fails to start after attempts
steps: Check fuel level in tank
Check fuel cock is open
Check battery charge
Check for air in fuel system - bleed if necessary
Check fuel filter for clogs
Check starter relay and fuses
Confirm marine gear in NEUTRAL
Check safety switch operation
procedures.expected_outcome: Cause of start failure identified and corrected
warnings: Never hold starter for longer than 15 seconds
